description: Record execution logs for commands, tests, builds, or any actions. Captures command, output, success status, and tags for future reference. Use this to build institutional memory of what commands work for this project. Log immediately after running commands - don't batch or delay.

logs.description: Array of execution logs to submit

command.description: The command or action that was executed

context.description: What we were trying to achieve - free text for searchability

durationMs.description: How long the execution took in milliseconds

skillName.description: The skill this execution relates to

tags.description: Tags for categorization (e.g., test, build, migration, deploy)

workingDirectory.description: Working directory where the command was run

name: submit_execution_logs
title: Submit Execution Logs
